chapter: Opening and New Orleans trumpet players
title: Outstanding trumpet players Punch heard in his youth
summary: Punch names Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Louis Armstrong, King Oliver and others, and which older men he met.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: And what's your name, Paul? Paul Crawford. Dick Allen is my name. So, we got everybody's name here. All right. Now, I guess I wanted to talk to you about trumpet playing, particularly in the old days. Who were some of the outstanding trumpet players you heard when you were young?

Well, in my time, there was Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, Ricard, Louis Armstrong, King Oliver and them. Of course, King Oliver and them were those brothers. King Oliver and Louis Criddy Kepert and them kind of fellas. Another fella by the name of Shatz.
He was older than you or your age?
Shatz? No, he's in our class. Yeah.
Who are some of the older ones?
Well, I didn't know nobody but King Oliver and Bunk Johnson. I never met Buddy Bowling.
